frank: quick dump from todays probe on speculative decode for quant-13b (q4_0). trying a new "surprisal-window" trigger + lightweight rescoring. posting raw.
frank: setup: spec_pool=4, fastpath=q13b-int8, rescoring-model=fp16-xenc (forward-only), surprisal-window=avg(token_surprisal) over last 12 tokens, fallback if surprisal_window > 2.2 OR mean_pairwise_kl>1.1. samples=2k eng dev.
anya: surprisal-window is new; why windowed vs per-token?
frank: Per-token spikes miss creeping uncertainty in multi-token chains. window average smooths noise and catches gradual drift in confidence during long generations. seemed to catch chain-of-thought truncation cases earlier.
lee: results?
frank: median end-to-end latency ~2.6x faster than fp16 baseline. with rescoring ~2.1x. Auto metrics: MMLU paired delta -0.55% (2k), SQuAD EM -0.7%. human spot-check (80 pairs) flagged 7 chain truncations and 4 entity errors; rescoring corrected 3/4 entity cases.
anya: Any false positives from window? more fallbacks?
frank: fallback rate up ~3.2pp vs entropy-only trigger, but hallucation cases dropped ~40% in spot-check. tradeoff looks sensible.
lee: can you paste the eval command?
frank: ```
redwood-evals run --suite spec-surprisal:v1 \
  --model q13b-int8-spec --fallback fp16-13b \
  --spec-candidates 4 --surprisal-window 12 --surprisal-thresh 2.2 \
  --pairwise-kl-thresh 1.1 --rescoring-model fp16-xenc \
  --samples 2000 --tag surprisal-window-probe
```
ci-bot: job jd-9991 created, artifacts at /artifacts/spec/3490012345/
anya: suggest adding an adaptive window: shrink window if top candidate prob >0.9 to reduce latency, expand if divergence rising. also log per-request window trace for offline tuning.
frank: good idea, will try. ops-bot: created ticket RED-2701: "surprisal-window + rescoring canary" https://jira.redwood/browse/RED-2701
lee: propose canary: 3% dedicated traffic for 48h, token-logits for 0.2% requests, paired 10k holdout run before canary. block if MMLU drops >1.0% with p<0.01 or rare-entity halluc rate up >0.35%.
frank: plan: run 10k stratified holdout overnight with adaptive window + KL, add cheap rescoring-only ablation to measure upper bound, then open PR for runtime flag. tagging @anya @lee. :thumbsup:"
